milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the oak trapdoor (at spawn-relative position [3, 2, 0]) and face toward it, modeling that the player can see and identify the block. Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the trapdoor at the doorway top. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the soul campfire (at spawn-relative position [6, 0, 0]) and face toward it, modeling that the player can see and identify the block with its distinctive blue flames. Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player is inside or at the entrance of the room. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking at the campfire.
